facts.business: Jasch Industries Ltd manufactures PVC/PU synthetic leather (coated fabrics) primarily for the footwear industry, with diversification into automobile upholstery, sports goods, and garment industries.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Management hopes to do better in the financial year 2025-26 despite challenges.

key_risks: Competition risk from larger entities and cheaper imports
Force majeure and act of God
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions were on arm's length basis and in the ordinary course of business. No material related party transactions with promoters, directors, management or their relatives that could have potential conflict with company's interests. Details in Form AOC-2 (Annexure E) and Note 36 to Financial Statements.
